pages.title: This phone
pages.purpose: Manage OpenCode 2 on this phone, inside the app or in Termux: set up, start, connect, recover an unfinished automatic upgrade, update, add tools, inspect logs and storage, and remove the managed server. Upgrading a managed OpenCode 1 server preserves its original data; choosing OpenCode 1 is no longer offered.
gates: host: widget.kind ?? defaultPhoneHostKind(connection) (the server in use, else a saved in-app profile, else Termux)

elements.label: Set up OpenCode on this phone
elements.effect: _setUp: in app openPhoneSetupStart; Termux openPhoneSetupTermux(firstSetup: true) (the Termux host of phone-setup-progress); re-reads the host on return.

elements.label: Set up OpenCode on this phone (Termux)
elements.effect: _setUp for the Termux host: openPhoneSetupTermux(context, firstSetup: true).

elements.label: Show progress
elements.effect: _showProgress: in app openPhoneSetupProgress; Termux openPhoneSetupTermux(job: update), which follows the running manager job.

elements.label: Try OpenCode 2 again
elements.effect: Retry an unfinished automatic move to OpenCode 2 through openPhoneSetupTermux. The old history remains preserved on disk.
gates: host.state == needsYou && host.switchTarget != null (Termux recovery only)

elements.label: Start the server on this phone
elements.effect: _start: host.start(l10n) (in app BuiltinServerStarter.start; Termux LocalServerControls.restart), then connects when no other server is in use.
gates: host.state in {stopped, needsYou} and no unfinished automatic upgrade

elements.label: Connect to This phone
elements.effect: _connect: connection.connect(host.profile), then pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(/home).
gates: host.state == running && not connected to it && host.profile != null

elements.label: Stop the server on this phone
elements.effect: _stop: confirmStopLocalServer, then host.stop(l10n) (in app BuiltinLinux.stopServer; Termux LocalServerControls.stop, which disables crash recovery and disconnects).

elements.label: Update OpenCode on this phone
elements.effect: _update: in app runPhoneServerAction(update) (SetupEngine.run(opencode) then the progress screen); Termux: alert when conversations are busy, else a showKitConfirm (this-phone-update-confirm, Update) then openPhoneSetupTermux(job: update). Replaces termux-setup-update-sheet.
gates: hidden while an automatic upgrade is unfinished
off while starting, stopping or setting up

elements.label: Add tools to this phone
elements.effect: _addTools: in app runPhoneServerAction(addTools): the Customize sheet in add mode, then SetupEngine.run(ids, adding) and the progress screen with only the new components.

elements.label: Add tools to this phone (Termux)
elements.effect: _addTools for Termux: a KitSheet with the AI Team onboarding block and the Claude Code row.

elements.label: Installed on this phone
elements.effect: KitExpandRow: unfolds one done row per installed part (in app: required components plus SetupEngine.installedOptional(); Termux: Linux base and OpenCode).

elements.label: Storage on this phone
elements.effect: In app: the measured size (BuiltinLinuxStatus.bytesUsed) as the row value; no tap.

elements.label: Restart after a crash
elements.effect: ManagedServerRecoveryOption: turns automatic restart of the Termux server on or off (ManagedServerRecovery).
gates: host.kind == termux && a Termux-managed profile is saved

elements.label: Keep running in the background
elements.effect: openKeepRunningScreen(context).

elements.label: Open a terminal on this phone
elements.effect: runPhoneServerAction(terminal): pushKitPage(TerminalPage(initialSource: phone)).

elements.label: Remove OpenCode from this phone
elements.effect: runPhoneServerAction(remove): the remove-from-phone sheet (keep projects by default, or delete everything).
gates: off while setting up, starting or stopping

elements.label: Details
elements.effect: Last on the page, collapsed by default (P1.5): opening it reads host.readLog() (in app BuiltinLinux.serverLog; Termux the manager install log and server output) into the one KitLogPanel ('this-phone-log'), titled by the server ("OpenCode 1.18.29") and re-read while the server runs.

elements.label: Running on this phone
elements.effect: Opens Running on this phone. Its line is the status about what runs: left behind, heavy, near Android's limit of 32, else how many run and their memory.
gates: host.kind == inApp and a process reading with something in it (read when This phone opens and every 15 s while it is in front)

pages.title: Setting up OpenCode on this phone
pages.purpose: Phone setup v2 screen B: a thin host for SetupProgressView. The job runs natively under a foreground service, so leaving this screen never stops it; coming back re-reads it. A first setup hands off to screen C (Ready) when done; an update or added tools just close back to where they were opened. The Termux host (PhoneSetupTermuxScreen, lib/ui/screens/phone_setup/phone_setup_termux_screen.dart, slice P1.3/P1.5 (2026-09-27)) draws the old Termux wizard as the same SetupProgressView checklist: Get Termux and Connect Termux once are rows only the person can do, then Linux base, OpenCode and Start OpenCode follow the Termux manager; a failure is a failed row with Continue setup. A first setup ends on home-shell, an update or a switch closes back to This phone. The persisted Termux job variant (PhoneSetupTermuxJobScreen, P5.3) also hosts SetupProgressView and hands first setup completion to Ready; its Get Termux, permission and resume actions are listed here.

reachedFrom.note: PhoneSetupWelcomeEntry's action button while a job is running or stopped part way (welcome-phone-setup-action)

reachedFrom.trigger: phone setup notification tap while the job is running/stopped/failed/cancelled (openPhoneSetupFromNotification, phone_setup_routes.dart:88-124)

elements.label: Continue
elements.effect: _continue(): re-runs the job's own component ids (or the defaults), resuming a stopped/interrupted/failed job.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: _cancel(): showConfirmSheet, then on confirm SetupEngine.cancel().

pages.title: Stop setting up?
pages.purpose: Confirms stopping the running setup job.

elements.label: Stop

elements.label: Keep going

pages.title: OpenCode is ready
pages.purpose: Phone setup v2 screen C: the agent is running, so the only thing left is a place to work. One step: a celebration drawing (SetupReadyScene, played once), 'OpenCode is ready', one name field whose primary 'Create and open' makes the project and lands in its first conversation, and the quiet 'Open a folder instead', which opens the folder sheet only when tapped (never on its own, so there is one name field on screen). Takes the progress screen's place (pushReplacement) so Back never returns to a finished setup.

reachedFrom.note: automatic hand-off, not a tap: when firstSetup and the job reaches SetupState.done (phone_setup_progress_screen.dart:78-92)

reachedFrom.trigger: phone setup notification tap when the job is done, firstSetup and screen C was not shown yet for this job (openPhoneSetupFromNotification, phone_setup_routes.dart:108-115)

pages.title: Remove OpenCode from this phone?
pages.purpose: The remove-from-phone sheet (P0.7/P1.5): says what survives. The default removes OpenCode and its tools, keeps the projects and names the space that comes back (BuiltinLinux.projectStorage, said only when measured); Delete everything is the heavy path.

elements.effect: Disconnects from the in-app server, BuiltinLinux.uninstall() (keeps /root/projects), then deleteProfileAndLocalData for every in-app profile.

elements.label: Delete everything
elements.effect: The alternative: closes this question and asks the typed-name delete.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Closes the question; nothing changes.

pages.title: Delete OpenCode and every project?
pages.purpose: The heavy delete: OpenCode, its tools and every project, with the space that comes back; the confirm stays off until the app name (OpenCode) is typed.

elements.label: [type OpenCode]
elements.effect: typedName: BuiltinLinux.deletionConfirmationName; enables the confirm when it matches.

elements.label: Delete everything
elements.effect: BuiltinLinux.remove(alsoDeleteProjects: true, confirmationName: OpenCode), then forgets every in-app profile.
